subtopics.label: Police Rescues from Lake Ontario
subtopics.summary: This cluster discusses various incidents where men have been rescued from Lake Ontario, often involving police. Rescues include individuals pulled from frigid waters after falling in [116208969019034801], a suspect fleeing Toronto police by jumping into icy waters after a stabbing [115838756706518114], and a man rescued after a small plane landed in the lake near downtown Toronto [114440244319653301]. The posts consistently highlight the role of police in these rescue operations.
